# Test 2: Zero-Override Custom Goods & Buildings Registry Load Verification
oe_ai3_test_goods_buildings_load = {
	year = 1337
	end_year = 1340
	fail_on_end_year = yes
	success = {
		any_goods = {
			this = goods:oe_steam_engines
		}
		any_building_type = {
			this = building_type:oe_stm_steam_ironworks
		}
		any_building_type = {
			this = building_type:oe_byz_parish_hospital
		}
	}
	success_child = {
		desc = "Custom produced goods loaded"
		trigger = {
			any_goods = { this = goods:oe_steam_engines }
		}
	}
	success_child = {
		desc = "Custom industrial and civic buildings loaded"
		trigger = {
			any_building_type = { this = building_type:oe_stm_steam_ironworks }
			any_building_type = { this = building_type:oe_byz_parish_hospital }
		}
	}
}

# Test 3: Decoupled Global Kernel Variable & Tick Health Verification
oe_ai3_test_global_kernel_health = {
	year = 1338
	end_year = 1342
	fail_on_end_year = yes
	success = {
		has_global_variable = oe_gk_init
		has_global_variable = oe_gk_tick_count
		global_var:oe_gk_tick_count >= 1
		has_global_variable = oe_gk_y_count
	}
	success_child = {
		desc = "Global kernel initialized and ticking"
		trigger = {
			has_global_variable = oe_gk_init
			has_global_variable = oe_gk_tick_count
			global_var:oe_gk_tick_count >= 1
		}
	}
	success_child = {
		desc = "Global kernel yearly dispatcher active"
		trigger = {
			has_global_variable = oe_gk_y_count
			global_var:oe_gk_y_count >= 1
		}
	}
}
